rules.delivery: productType=item, deliveryPayload.definition.Items=[{Blueprint,Amount,Quality,ForceBlueprint:false}], itemBlueprint=Items[0].Blueprint, quantity=Amount, quality=integer Quality (fractional -> 0, as import-arkshop-catalog), isBlueprint=false, requiredCapabilities=["delivery.item.v1"] -> plugin items[{blueprint,quantity: Amount x units bought,quality,isBlueprint}] -> GiveItemToPlayer
rules.legacy: legacy arkshop:* rows keep price, quantity, quality, name, category and payload exactly; only a missing description is filled and a missing image added; clearly undeliverable rows (no/invalid blueprint, ASA, mod, mobile, payload rejected by the builder) are deactivated and listed in report.legacyFlagged; everything else questionable is only reported (report.legacyReview); a row whose name does not match the item it delivers (not just a misspelling) gets no image (row.imageHold) until the owner fixes it
rules.sellability: ASA path/category, mobile, not on Steam PC, mod path/category, admin/debug/cheat, mission/VR/quest, unobtainable/WIP/disambiguation, non-items (implant, generic classes, generic Dermis), fertilized eggs, eggs of creatures that cannot breed on PC (Griffin, Phoenix), a PC page without a map whose same-name page is mobile/console-only, Genesis HLNA exchange lootcrates -> NOT_SELLABLE; unproven official-map /Game/Mods roots and anything not on the wiki or under an unproven root -> NOT_SELLABLE "unverified"; Aquatica (/Game/Abyss) follows the owner opt-in given for Aquatica creatures
rules.quantity: non-stackable (wiki stack size 1 or unknown) -> 1 per purchase; stackable -> median legacy pack of the category (all categories when < 5 samples) rounded to a nice number and capped by the wiki stack size (one stack, one definition entry); ammo without a wiki stack size stacks to 100; single-use weapon-class tools (wiki "Tools") -> 1; boss drops in a small pack (<= 10, or their legacy bundle amount)
rules.category: draft category, or the wiki category for new rows; the blueprint class overrides a keyword category where it is clearly wrong (PrimalItemConsumable_/Structure_/non-saddle Armor_ filed under Skins, PrimalItemTrophy_ -> Items); names drop the wiki "(Survival Evolved/Ascended)" suffix and a draft named after a wiki alias page takes the page that matches its asset
rules.quality: Primitive (0) unless most legacy non-stackable rows of the category use a quality (then that category median, e.g. saddles/armor)
rules.price: legacy per-unit median of the narrowest group with >= 5 single-blueprint legacy rows: category+sub-type (tek/platform/costume) -> sub-type across categories -> category -> all, split by stackable/non-stackable; x quantity; rounded (integers kept, < 20 to 1, < 200 to 5, else 10); minimum 1 IC; items the owner sells only inside legacy bundles use the median bundle per-unit price instead; apex drops / alpha apex drops / trophies / artifacts in no bundle use the median bundle share of their kind (report.newPriceFlags boss_drop_pool); armor pieces without an Armor group use the per-piece share of the owner armor-set bundles (armor_set_pool, keeps tiers monotonic); rows priced by a share/pool/fallback far below related new rows are flagged below_related
rules.dedupe: one sellable product per blueprint + quantity + quality + isBlueprint; a draft or wiki item whose blueprint a single-blueprint legacy row already sells stays inactive / is skipped as "duplicate of <key>"
rules.description: new rows and legacy rows without a description: "<Name> x<qty>"
